title: All About Butterflies
checkpoint: Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — non-fiction, Phonics Screening Check review week, real facts about butterflies.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — non-fiction, Phonics Screening Check review week, real facts about butterflies.

pages.text: Ned spots a flying bug with bright wings.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling looking up at a colourful butterfly fluttering just above the long grass.

pages.text: It starts out small and green on a leaf.
pages.illustration: A small green caterpillar crawling along a leaf, the long grass around it.
The caterpillar munching steadily along the edge of a green leaf.
The caterpillar now much plumper and longer than before, resting on a thick stem.

pages.text: It rests inside a hard case.
pages.illustration: The caterpillar hanging still, now enclosed inside a smooth, hard, pale green case.

pages.text: Inside the case, wings start to form.
pages.illustration: A faint outline of folded wings visible through the thin wall of the hard case.

pages.text: At last, it is out of the case.
pages.illustration: The case splitting open as a butterfly slowly climbs out, wings damp and folded.
The butterfly resting with its bright, patterned wings now open and drying in the sun.

pages.text: It lands on a bright flower.
pages.illustration: The butterfly landing gently on a bright flower among the long grass.

pages.text: Ned is glad he spots it there.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling watching happily as the butterfly rests on the flower.
